meta.name: Aircord Observability Trust Memory
meta.description: A dark, compact technical dashboard DNA synthesized from Linear, MotherDuck, and Datadog Cloud Observability, adapted for an inspectable air-quality trust-memory decision packet.

source_references.name: Linear homepage
source_references.observed_patterns: Premium product hierarchy, generous whitespace, precise typography, product UI as evidence, and calm high-contrast surfaces.

source_references.name: MotherDuck homepage
source_references.observed_patterns: Approachable infrastructure storytelling, technical concepts made legible, natural-language-to-SQL framing, and product sections organized as a data narrative.

source_references.name: Datadog Cloud Observability
source_references.observed_patterns: Single-pane observability language, status-led cards, dashboards, metrics/logs/traces as connected evidence, and operational credibility.

accent.role: trusted/live signal, proof status, links, and decision emphasis

neutral.usage: Green-black neutral scale for canvas, layered panels, restrained borders, metadata, body copy, and near-white ink.

color.contrast_strategy: Near-white data values on deep green-black surfaces with muted green-gray metadata, thin teal-gray dividers, mint reserved for trust/proof, and amber reserved for downweighted states.

typography.font_style_notes: Space Grotesk creates decisive metric hierarchy, DM Sans keeps dense explanations readable, and DM Mono distinguishes identifiers, timestamps, formulas, and source evidence.

spacing.section_rhythm: Dense 12-20px internal card rhythm, 48-64px supporting section breaks, and no large brochure-like vertical gaps.

layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with asymmetric hero emphasis

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px teal-gray borders; stronger mint, amber, or danger tint only for meaningful state and evidence callouts

elevation.depth_cues: Surface lightness and thin borders carry most depth; low-opacity shadows only separate primary panels from the canvas.

iconography.preferred_set: Status dots, typographic arrows, and minimal inline symbols; no icon-library dependency

motion.entrance_pattern: none; data is immediately available and stable
motion.philosophy: nearly motionless; transitions are limited to focus and link feedback

components.button_style: compact dark-surface controls with mint text or borders and clear mint focus rings
components.input_style: dark inputs with a 1px teal-gray border and crisp mint focus accent
components.card_style: dark teal-charcoal evidence cards on a green-black canvas, thin state-aware borders, and tight label/value rhythm
components.navigation_pattern: quiet top utility bar with product mark, data source, and section anchors
components.modal_style: not needed for the single-page proof surface; use inline disclosure instead
components.list_style: dense evidence rows with timestamp, actor, state chip, and monospace identifier
components.component_notes: The first viewport is a four-part decision packet: conflict, memory, decision, and proof. Supporting evidence, audit, vector, backtest, MCP, and caveats follow in compact grids.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A control room for one remembered decision, where every number has a source trail.
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary cloud software with editorial restraint

visual_language.whitespace_usage: controlled around the hero, compact inside the decision packet and evidence cards, with no brochure-like gaps
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Heavy at the headline and memory decision, distributed through evidence rails and proof cards.
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero decision followed by progressive evidence reveal
visual_language.texture_usage: a very faint static technical grid behind solid dark surfaces; no glow or gradient decoration

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast plus color weight and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom investigation with left-to-right evidence comparisons
composition.grouping_strategy: semantic bands: decision, sensor/reference, audit, validation, access
composition.negative_space_role: separates semantic proof groups while keeping the main decision visible within one screen

imagery.photo_treatment: none; product proof uses live data instead of photography
imagery.illustration_style: minimal line diagrams only when needed
imagery.graphic_elements: small signal bars, rules, dots, and evidence connectors
imagery.pattern_usage: very faint technical grid in hero background only

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: mint text or border feedback on actual links only; static evidence cards do not lift
interaction_feel.loading_style: content-first skeleton or compact status line; never an infinite blank state

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: subtle suggestion and direct evidence links
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain what is missing, identify the source, and offer the exact next command

overview.fallback_strategy: disable nonessential motion under prefers-reduced-motion and preserve static data layout

background_effects.description: No animated background; use a static deep green-black canvas and a faint technical grid behind solid proof surfaces.

particle_systems.description: No particles; evidence should remain legible.

3d_elements.description: No 3D elements; the product is an inspectable data surface.

cursor_effects.description: Use the system cursor for dependable dashboard interaction.

image_effects.description: No image layer is required for the proof surface.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Use only a faint static grid, focus-ring feedback, and semantic state colors. The decision packet, data, and audit trail are the visual interest; avoid decorative motion, glass, neon glow, and gradient effects.
